spec.conclusion: Function.Surjective s → IsUTF I G → IsUTF J G
spec.proof:
by
  rintro hs ⟨L, hfree, hEq⟩
  refine ⟨fun j => L (s j), fun j => hfree _, ?_⟩
  ext a b
  rw [hEq, SimpleGraph.iSup_adj, SimpleGraph.iSup_adj]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hs i
    exact ⟨j, hi⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    exact ⟨s j, hj⟩
